critical_code_review_comments: _can_read_across_operators is scoped cleanly to READ only — mutation endpoints remain operator-only. Doctrine 5 asymmetry preserved: DPO can inspect but cannot commit through another operator's wizard.
viewer_can_mutate sidecar is the right primitive — client renders the read-only banner off it rather than diffing identities client-side. Clean server-authoritative pattern.

verdict_ref + hold_reason_verbatim + held_since_iso + proposed_spend_usd + auto_run_ceiling_usd sidecars in the GET envelope give the wizard everything it needs to render the hold ceremony without any extra roundtrips.
Mobile fix via wrapper overflow-x:auto (rather than collapsing to cards) preserves the tabular affordance while removing the page-level overflow — right compromise for the rule-inventory density.
